```{r}
load(here(data_dir, "analysis", "df_long.RData"))

df_long <- df_long |> 
  mutate(conjoint_choice = as.numeric(conjoint_choice),
         conjoint_sex = factor(conjoint_sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
         conjoint_age = as.numeric(conjoint_age),
         conjoint_party = factor(conjoint_party, 
                                 levels = c("Labour", "Conservatives", "Liberal Democrats", 
                                            "Green Party", "Reform UK")),
         conjoint_dem = factor(conjoint_dem, 
                     levels = c("undemocratic", "democratic"),
                     labels = c("Undemocratic", "Democratic")),
         conjoint_eco = factor(conjoint_eco, 
                     levels = c("Neither good nor bad reputation on economic matters",
                                "Good at handling economic matters",
                                "Bad at handling economic matters"),
                     labels = c("Neither", "Economically good", "Economically bad"))) |> 
  mutate(conjoint_age_z = standardise(conjoint_age))

# Variable lookup table for later
variable_lookup <- tibble(
  variable = c("conjoint_sex", "conjoint_age_z", "conjoint_party", "conjoint_dem", "conjoint_eco"),
  variable_nice = c("Sex", "Age", "Party", "Democratic behaviour", "Economic reputation")
)
```

```{r}
# brms settings
bayes_seed <- 42
chains <- 4
iter <- 4000
warmup <- floor(iter/2)
adapt_delta <- 0.90
max_treedepth <- 10
```

```{r}
# marginaleffects settings
options(marginaleffects_posterior_interval = "hdi")
options(marginaleffects_posterior_center = stats::median)
```

## Main Models

### Model 0 — Conjoint Choices

```{r}
f_cj0 <- bf(conjoint_choice ~ conjoint_dem + conjoint_sex + conjoint_age_z + conjoint_party + conjoint_eco + (1 | id))

priors_cj0 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
cj0 <- brm(
  data = df_long,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  formula = f_cj0,
  prior = priors_cj0,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
  file = here(model_dir, "cj0.rds")
)
```

```{r}
print(cj0)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

Thanks go to Andrew Heiss and his [amazing blog](https://www.andrewheiss.com/blog/2023/07/25/conjoint-bayesian-frequentist-guide/#finding-conjoint-amces-and-marginal-means-bayesianly) from where I borrow much of this code!

##### Average Marginal Component Effects (AMCEs)

```{r}
cj0_slopes <- avg_slopes(cj0, 
                         newdata = datagrid(id = unique(df_long$id))) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(Contrast = if_else(Contrast == "dY/dX", "Age (1 SD increase)", Contrast),
         across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) 

cj0_slopes |> tt()

cj0_slopes |> tt() |> 
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "conjoint_amces.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Create levels for all variables 
cj0_levels <- tibble(
  variable = c("conjoint_sex", "conjoint_age_z", "conjoint_party", "conjoint_dem", "conjoint_eco"),
  levels = "") |> 
  mutate(levels = case_when(
    variable == "conjoint_sex" ~ list(levels(df_long$conjoint_sex)),
    variable == "conjoint_age_z" ~ list("1 SD increase"),
    variable == "conjoint_party" ~ list(levels(df_long$conjoint_party)),
    variable == "conjoint_dem" ~ list(levels(df_long$conjoint_dem)),
    variable == "conjoint_eco" ~ list(levels(df_long$conjoint_eco))
  )) |> 
  unnest(levels) |>
  mutate(term = paste0(variable, levels))

# Calculate Average Marginal Effects and get Posterior Draws
cj0_mfx <- cj0 |>
  avg_slopes(newdata = datagrid(id = unique(df_long$id))) |>  
  posterior_draws() 

# Reshape Results (handle continuous and categorical separately)
cj0_mfx_nested <- cj0_mfx |>
  mutate(
    variable_level = if_else(
      term == "conjoint_age_z",
      "1 SD increase",
      str_extract(contrast, "^[^-]+(?= - )")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(term, variable_level) |>
  nest()

# Join Data
cj0_plot_data <- cj0_levels |>
  left_join(
    cj0_mfx_nested,
    by = join_by(variable == term, levels == variable_level)
  ) |>
  mutate(data = map_if(data, is.null, ~ tibble(draw = 0, estimate = 0))) |>
  unnest(data) |>
  left_join(variable_lookup, by = join_by(variable)) |>
  mutate(across(c(levels, variable_nice), ~fct_inorder(.)))
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 8

cj0_plot_data |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(x = draw, y = levels, fill = variable_nice, color = variable_nice)) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  stat_slab(
    data = ~filter(.x, draw != 0),
    aes(thickness = after_stat(pdf)),
    scale = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.7,
    normalize = "groups"
  ) +
  
  stat_pointinterval(
    .width = c(.95),
    point_interval = "median_hdi",
    position = position_nudge(y = -0.1),
    point_size = 2,
  ) +
  
  facet_col(facets = "variable_nice", scales = "free_y", space = "free") +
  
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent, 
    limits = c(-0.5, 0.5), 
    breaks = seq(-0.5, 0.5, by = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(add = 0.025)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Probability Change to Choose Candidate (vs. Reference)", 
    y = NULL,  
    title = "Average Marginal Component Effects",
    subtitle = "Posterior Distributions with Median and 95% HDI"
  ) +
  
  theme_allround() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2)
  )

ggsave(here(figure_dir, "conjoint_amce.svg"), height = 7, width = 8, web_fonts = falo_svg_fonts())
```

##### Marginal Means

```{r}
cj0_mm_sex <- avg_predictions(cj0, by = "conjoint_sex") |> as_tibble()
cj0_mm_party <- avg_predictions(cj0, by = "conjoint_party") |> as_tibble()
cj0_mm_dem <- avg_predictions(cj0, by = "conjoint_dem") |> as_tibble()
cj0_mm_eco <- avg_predictions(cj0, by = "conjoint_eco") |> as_tibble()
cj0_mm_age <- avg_predictions(cj0, 
                              newdata = datagrid(conjoint_age_z = c(-1, 0, 1)),
                              by = "conjoint_age_z") |> as_tibble()

cj0_mm <- bind_rows(cj0_mm_sex, cj0_mm_party, cj0_mm_dem, cj0_mm_eco, cj0_mm_age)
```

```{r}
cj0_mm_table <- cj0_mm |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("conjoint_"), 
    names_to = "Attribute", 
    values_to = "Level", 
    values_transform = as.character, 
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    # Clean the Attribute names 
    Attribute = Attribute |> 
      str_remove("conjoint_") |> 
      str_remove("_z") |>       # Removes "_z" from age
      str_to_title(),           # Capitalizes the first letter
    
    # Recode the Age Levels
    Level = case_when(
      Attribute == "Age" & Level == "-1" ~ "-1 SD",
      Attribute == "Age" & Level == "0"  ~ "Mean",
      Attribute == "Age" & Level == "1"  ~ "+1 SD",
      TRUE ~ Level 
    )
  ) |> 
  # Final Selection and Formatting
  select(
    Attribute, 
    Level,
    Median = estimate,
    "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
    "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

cj0_mm_table |> tt()
```

### Model 1 — Primary Model

```{r}
f_cj1 <- bf(conjoint_choice ~ conjoint_dem * exp_condition + conjoint_sex + conjoint_age_z + conjoint_party + conjoint_eco + (1 | id))

priors_cj1 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
cj1 <- brm(
  data = df_long,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  formula = f_cj1,
  prior = priors_cj1,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
  file = here(model_dir, "cj1.rds")
)
```

```{r}
print(cj1)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

##### Average Comparisons

```{r}
cj1_main_com <- avg_comparisons(cj1, 
                                variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise")) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) 

cj1_main_com |> tt()
```


```{r}
cj1_com <- avg_comparisons(cj1, 
                           variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"), 
                           by = "exp_condition") |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Condition = exp_condition,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) 

cj1_com |> tt()
```

```{r}
cj1_hyp <- avg_comparisons(cj1, 
                           variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"), 
                           by = "exp_condition", 
                           hypothesis = ~pairwise) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) 

cj1_hyp |> tt()
```

##### Conditional Marginal Means

```{r}
cj1_mms <- predictions(
  cj1,
  by = c("conjoint_dem", "exp_condition"),
  allow_new_levels = TRUE) |> 
  posterior_draws()

cj1_mms |> 
  group_by(conjoint_dem, exp_condition) |> 
  median_qi(draw) |> 
  tt()
```

### Model 2 — Interaction with Age Group

```{r}
f_cj2 <- bf(conjoint_choice ~ conjoint_dem * exp_condition * age_group + conjoint_sex + conjoint_age_z + conjoint_party + conjoint_eco + (1 | id))
```

```{r}
#| output: false
cj2 <- brm(
  data = df_long,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  formula = f_cj2,
  prior = priors_cj1,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
  file = here(model_dir, "cj2.rds")
)
```

```{r}
print(cj2)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

AMCE of democratic behaviour within each age group (averaged across conditions):

```{r}
cj2_mod <- avg_comparisons(cj2, 
                           variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"), 
                           by = "age_group")

cj2_mod |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         `Age Group` = age_group,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> 
  tt()
```

Differences in the AMCE of democratic behaviour between age groups:

```{r}
cj2_mod_diffs <- avg_comparisons(cj2, 
                                 variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"), 
                                 by = "age_group", 
                                 hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(`Age Group Difference` = hypothesis,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

cj2_mod_diffs |> tt()
```

Treatment effects on the AMCE of democratic behaviour within each age group:

```{r}
cj2_hyp <- avg_comparisons(cj2,
                           variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"),
                           by = c("exp_condition", "age_group"),
                           hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise | age_group)

cj2_hyp |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
         `Age Group` = age_group,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  tt()
```

Differences in the treatment effects between age groups:

```{r}
cj2_hyp_diffs <- cj2_hyp |>
  posterior_draws() |>
  select(drawid, hypothesis, age_group, draw) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = age_group, values_from = draw) |>
  mutate(`(22-26 years) - (16-21 years)` = `22-26 years` - `16-21 years`) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("("), names_to = "difference", values_to = "estimate") |>
  group_by(hypothesis, difference) |>
  median_hdi(estimate, .width = 0.95) |>
  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
         `Age Group Difference` = difference,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = .lower,
         "95% HDI Upper" = .upper
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

cj2_hyp_diffs |> tt()
```

```{r}
                           by = c("exp_condition", "gender"),

cj3_hyp |>

  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
```

```{r}
cj3_hyp_diffs <- cj3_hyp |>

  select(drawid, hypothesis, gender, draw) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = gender, values_from = draw) |>
  mutate(`(female) - (male)` = female - male,
         `(other) - (male)` = other - male,
         `(other) - (female)` = other - female) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("("), names_to = "difference", values_to = "estimate") |>
  group_by(hypothesis, difference) |>
  median_hdi(estimate, .width = 0.95) |>
  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
         `Gender Difference` = difference,
         Median = estimate,

         "95% HDI Upper" = .upper
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

cj3_hyp_diffs |> tt()
```

## Supplementary Models

### Model 4 — Control for Demographics

Each control is interacted with democratic behaviour, as main effects of respondent characteristics would only shift the overall probability of choosing a candidate.

```{r}
df_control <- df_long |> 
  mutate(ideology = left_right / 10,
         education_level = coalesce(education_level, education)) |> 
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
f_cj4 <- bf(conjoint_choice ~ conjoint_dem * exp_condition + conjoint_sex + conjoint_age_z + conjoint_party + conjoint_eco + conjoint_dem * (scale(participant_age) + gender + ideology + education_level + living_standard) + (1 | id))

priors_cj4 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
cj4 <- brm(
  data = df_control,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  formula = f_cj4,
  prior = priors_cj4,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
  file = here(model_dir, "cj4.rds")
)
```

```{r}
print(cj4)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

Treatment effects on the AMCE of democratic behaviour, adjusted for the controls:

```{r}
cj4_hyp <- avg_comparisons(cj4,
                           variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"),
                           by = "exp_condition",
                           hypothesis = ~pairwise) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

cj4_hyp |> tt()
```

Comparison with Model 1 (unadjusted):

```{r}
left_join(cj1_hyp, cj4_hyp,
          by = "Hypothesis",
          suffix = c(" (Unadjusted)", " (Adjusted)")) |>
  tt()
```

### Model 5 — Pre-Registered Sample Only

Participants aged 16-21 or participants who were recontacted:

```{r}
df_prereg <- df_long |> 
  filter(age_group == "16-21 years" | sample_type == "recontact")
```

```{r}
f_cj5 <- bf(conjoint_choice ~ conjoint_dem * exp_condition + conjoint_sex + conjoint_age_z + conjoint_party + conjoint_eco + (1 | id))

priors_cj5 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
cj5 <- brm(
  data = df_prereg,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  formula = f_cj5,
  prior = priors_cj5,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
  file = here(model_dir, "cj5.rds")
)
```

```{r}
print(cj5)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

Treatment effects on the AMCE of democratic behaviour in the preregistered sample:

```{r}
cj5_hyp <- avg_comparisons(cj5, 
                           variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"), 
                           by = "exp_condition", 
                           hypothesis = ~pairwise) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) 

cj5_hyp |> tt()
```

### Party Model — Treatment Effects on Party Preferences

Does the treatment change how often candidates of each party are chosen? Marginal means are used rather than conditional AMCEs, because differences in AMCEs between conditions depend on the choice of reference level (Leeper et al., 2020). Only the party attribute is interacted with condition; the interaction of democratic behaviour with condition is tested in Model 1.

```{r}
f_cj_party <- bf(conjoint_choice ~ conjoint_party * exp_condition + conjoint_dem + conjoint_sex + conjoint_age_z + conjoint_eco + (1 | id))
```

```{r}
#| output: false
cj_party <- brm(
  data = df_long,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  formula = f_cj_party,
  prior = priors_cj1,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
  file = here(model_dir, "cj_party.rds")
)
```

```{r}
print(cj_party)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

Marginal means of party within each condition:

```{r}
cj_party_mm <- avg_predictions(cj_party, 
                               by = c("conjoint_party", "exp_condition"))

cj_party_mm |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Level = conjoint_party,
         Condition = exp_condition,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> 
  tt()
```

Treatment effects on the marginal means of party:

```{r}
cj_party_hyp <- avg_predictions(cj_party, 
                                by = c("conjoint_party", "exp_condition"), 
                                hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise | conjoint_party) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
         Level = conjoint_party,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

cj_party_hyp |> tt()
```

## Exploratory Moderation Models

Moderation of the treatment effects on the AMCE of democratic behaviour by subjective living standard, participant age (continuous), and parental ideology. Living standard: difficult and very difficult combined given the small number of respondents in "very difficult" (<5%). Continuous moderators are standardised (at the participant level) for estimation; treatment effects are reported at representative values (age 16, 21, 26; parental ideology 0, 5, 10), and moderation as the difference between the highest and lowest value.

```{r}
df_participants <- df_long |>
  distinct(id, participant_age, parental_ideology)

age_mean <- mean(df_participants$participant_age)
age_sd <- sd(df_participants$participant_age)
to_age_z <- \(x) (x - age_mean) / age_sd

pi_mean <- mean(df_participants$parental_ideology, na.rm = TRUE)
pi_sd <- sd(df_participants$parental_ideology, na.rm = TRUE)
to_pi_z <- \(x) (x - pi_mean) / pi_sd

df_long_het <- df_long |>
  mutate(
    living_standard = fct_collapse(
      living_standard,
      Comfortable = levels(living_standard)[1],
      Coping = levels(living_standard)[2],
      Difficult = levels(living_standard)[3:4]
    ) |> fct_rev(),
    participant_age_z = to_age_z(participant_age),
    parental_ideology_z = to_pi_z(parental_ideology)
  )

df_long_het |> distinct(id, living_standard) |> count(living_standard)
```

### Model 8 — Interaction with Living Standard

```{r}
f_cj8 <- bf(conjoint_choice ~ conjoint_dem * exp_condition * living_standard + conjoint_sex + conjoint_age_z + conjoint_party + conjoint_eco + (1 | id))
```

```{r}
#| output: false
cj8 <- brm(
  data = df_long_het,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  formula = f_cj8,
  prior = priors_cj1,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
  file = here(model_dir, "cj8.rds")
)
```

```{r}
print(cj8)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

AMCE of democratic behaviour within each level of living standard (averaged across conditions):

```{r}
cj8_mod <- avg_comparisons(cj8, 
                           variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"), 
                           by = "living_standard")

cj8_mod |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         `Living Standard` = living_standard,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> 
  tt()
```

Differences in the AMCE of democratic behaviour between levels of living standard:

```{r}
cj8_mod_diffs <- avg_comparisons(cj8, 
                                 variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"), 
                                 by = "living_standard", 
                                 hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(`Living Standard Difference` = hypothesis,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

cj8_mod_diffs |> tt()
```

Treatment effects on the AMCE of democratic behaviour within each level of living standard:

```{r}
cj8_hyp <- avg_comparisons(cj8,
                           variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"),
                           by = c("exp_condition", "living_standard"),
                           hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise | living_standard)

cj8_hyp |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
         `Living Standard` = living_standard,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  tt()
```

Differences in the treatment effects between levels of living standard:

```{r}
cj8_hyp_diffs <- cj8_hyp |>
  posterior_draws() |>
  select(drawid, hypothesis, living_standard, draw) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = living_standard, values_from = draw) |>
  mutate(`(Coping) - (Difficult)` = Coping - Difficult,
         `(Comfortable) - (Difficult)` = Comfortable - Difficult,
         `(Comfortable) - (Coping)` = Comfortable - Coping) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("("), names_to = "difference", values_to = "estimate") |>
  group_by(hypothesis, difference) |>
  median_hdi(estimate, .width = 0.95) |>
  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
         `Living Standard Difference` = difference,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = .lower,
         "95% HDI Upper" = .upper
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

cj8_hyp_diffs |> tt()
```

### Model 9 — Interaction with Age (Continuous)

```{r}

```

```{r}

  file = here(model_dir, "cj9.rds")
)
```

```{r}
print(cj9)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

AMCE of democratic behaviour at ages 16 and 26 (averaged across conditions; counterfactual grid over the observed data; every 4th posterior draw, i.e. 2,000 draws, to limit memory use):

```{r}
cj9_mod <- avg_comparisons(cj9, 
                            variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"), 
                            newdata = datagrid(participant_age_z = to_age_z(c(16, 26)),
                                               grid_type = "counterfactual"),
                            by = "participant_age_z", 
                            draw_ids = seq(1, 8000, by = 4))

cj9_mod |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(age = round(participant_age_z * age_sd + age_mean)) |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         `Age` = age,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> 
  tt()
```

Difference in the AMCE of democratic behaviour between 26 and 16:

```{r}
cj9_mod_diffs <- avg_comparisons(cj9, 
                                  variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"), 
                                  newdata = datagrid(participant_age_z = to_age_z(c(16, 26)),
                                                     grid_type = "counterfactual"),
                                  by = "participant_age_z", 
                                  hypothesis = ~ pairwise,
                                  draw_ids = seq(1, 8000, by = 4)) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(`Difference (26 vs. 16)` = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

cj9_mod_diffs |> tt()
```

Treatment effects on the AMCE of democratic behaviour at ages 16, 21, and 26 (counterfactual grid over the observed data; every 4th posterior draw, i.e. 2,000 draws, to limit memory use):

```{r}
cj9_hyp <- avg_comparisons(cj9,
                           variables = list("conjoint_dem" = "pairwise"),
                           newdata = datagrid(participant_age_z = to_age_z(c(16, 21, 26)),
                                              grid_type = "counterfactual"),
                           by = c("exp_condition", "participant_age_z"),
                           hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise | participant_age_z,
                           draw_ids = seq(1, 8000, by = 4))

cj9_hyp |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(age = round(participant_age_z * age_sd + age_mean)) |>
  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
         Age = age,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  tt()
```

Differences in the treatment effects between ages 26 and 16:

```{r}
cj9_hyp_diffs <- cj9_hyp |>
  posterior_draws() |>
  mutate(age = round(participant_age_z * age_sd + age_mean)) |>
  select(drawid, hypothesis, age, draw) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = age, values_from = draw) |>
  mutate(estimate = `26` - `16`) |>
  group_by(hypothesis) |>
  median_hdi(estimate, .width = 0.95) |>
  select(Hypothesis = hypothesis,
         `Difference (26 vs. 16)` = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = .lower,
         "95% HDI Upper" = .upper
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

cj9_hyp_diffs |> tt()
```
